name: Lunette
source:
"Understood. Now searching with the Black Canvas..."

Neo-fennec no. ???

A mysterious lady indeed and Regulus’s personal secretary who can remains calm and composed, no matter her situation.
Immaculate yet approachable, with the kindest of smiles, she is never seen without her Black Canvas seldevice, which was given to her by Regulus himself.
A sucker for cheese and salty blue boudin sausages.
